kali-server._comment: Official Kali MCP Server. Available after apt install mcp-kali-server. Can invoke any terminal tool such as nmap/nxc/curl/gobuster directly.

metasploit-mcp._comment: Metasploit Framework MCP interface. apt install metasploitmcp. Supports exploit/payload/session management.

hexstrike._comment: HexStrike AI MCP. apt install hexstrike-ai. Orchestrates automation across 150+ security tools.

pentestswarm._comment: Pentest Swarm AI. Swarm-intelligence autonomous pentest framework. go install or Docker. Supports --swarm mode.

anything-analyzer._comment: Browser automation + HTTP capture. Requires cloning the repo and starting it with pnpm dev.

idapro._comment: IDA Pro MCP. Requires IDA Pro for Linux + the ida-pro-mcp plugin. Port may increment up to 13350.

ghidra._comment: Ghidra MCP. apt install ghidra + the GhidraMCP plugin. Free IDA alternative.
